text: I asked Frodo to let me see the Ring once more, and I am ashamed of what happened next. The Rings of Power have brought nothing but grief.
Translations from the Elvish, volume three: notes on the Rings of Power and the smiths of Eregion.
Elrond's house is the best place for writing. Nobody hurries me and the food is excellent.
There and Back Again: the chapter about the riddles in the dark still needs work.
